messages:
Jules_CSM: SolaceBio going live in SG next Wed. They need header-and-ip allowlist on apac-proxy + short-term flexible QPS profile for a demo. Also flagged renewal pricing concerns in last call.
Asha (SolaceBio): Hi team Thanks! Demo window 2026-04-01 14:00 SGT. We can supply two source CIDRs: 198.51.100.128/30 and 203.0.113.200/32, and will send header X-Solace-Tenant: solace-demo. Target peak 150 qps but would like the ability to step-down/up during the 6h demo. Can you keep 10d logs? Compliance wants short retention.
Riya_SE: We can do hybrid matching (headers + CIDR) and configure a flexible QPS profile (min 40 -> peak 150 with manual step controls). Recommend auto-revoke after 6h, and enable 10d log retention with payload redaction. I'll prepare perf checklist and a quick cost delta for the demo.
Harold_NetOps: I'll stage the rule on apac-proxy-2. Planned manifest snippet: ```
allowlist:
  tenant: SLB-701
  match:
    headers:
      X-Solace-Tenant: "solace-demo"
    cidrs: ["198.51.100.128/30","203.0.113.200/32"]
qps_profile:
  min: 40
  peak: 150
  manual_steps_allowed: true
  duration: 6h
  expire_at: 2026-04-01T20:15:00+08:00
logging:
  retention_days: 10
  redact_payloads: true
notes: "demo - manual scaling; renewal follow-up"
```
ops-bot: Change staged by Harold_NetOps on apac-proxy-2. Staging ID: stg-6a1e. Will apply 10m before window.
Harold_NetOps: Applied patch stg-6a1e -> live. Header+CIDR rules active. QPS profile enabled; manual scale controls available to Solace on the console (with audit). Alerts: 5xx > 0.4% OR p95 token-latency > 320ms.
Asha (SolaceBio): Initial traffic looks good, hitting ~120 qps during load test. No 5xx. Thanks!
Jules_CSM: Noting renewal concern: Asha said cost is a blocker. Riya, can you produce a 6h cost estimate and a recommended pricing option (short pilot discount or committed-month credit) to present in the renewal packet?
Riya_SE: Yes I'll run token-level cost and amortized infra reservation if they need capacity. Will post numbers within 24h. Also will include optimization suggestions (prefix caching, smaller batch hints).
Asha (SolaceBio): Also request: keep request logs accessible to our security lead for 7 days via secure link.
Harold_NetOps: Confirmed: logs retained 10d; will provision secure-view link scoped to SLB-701 with 7d access and RBAC.
Jules_CSM: Great. I'll add renewal follow-up in CRM SLB-701 and schedule a 30-min renewal chat 3 days after demo. Riya, please attach the perf+cost doc to the CRM.
ops-bot: Audit note: config change for SLB-701 recorded (stg-6a1e -> live) by Harold_NetOps at 2026-04-01T13:50:00+08:00.
Harold_NetOps: Closing loop: auto-revoke scheduled; manual scale controls will be monitored. If error rate rises, I'll page oncall.
Jules_CSM: Thanks team  closing thread after renewal packet posted.
